meeting-prep-brief.name: Meeting Preparation Brief
meeting-prep-brief.description: Researches attendees and companies and delivers concise context, talking points, and discovery questions before meetings.

connections.purpose: Deliver an approved brief to a selected Slack channel or DM.
connections.setup_notes: Offer only when external delivery is wanted. Connect the recipient's account, resolve destination, confirm draft and recipient, then test. This does not publish an interactive agent.

connections.purpose: Search the web and retrieve source pages for attendee and company research.
connections.setup_notes: Ask whether to add Exa before connecting or attaching it, including an existing account. Explain live-research benefits and provider usage limits. Proceed only on explicit opt-in; otherwise use supplied-material mode. Never auto-add on import.

connections.purpose: Read selected upcoming meetings and attendee details.
connections.setup_notes: Offer Google Calendar during first-use setup; connect only if chosen. Otherwise accept pasted meeting details.

connections.purpose: Find relevant company and relationship context in HubSpot.
connections.setup_notes: Offer HubSpot during first-use setup; connect only if chosen. Otherwise use supplied notes.

connections.purpose: Find relevant prior conversations with meeting participants.
connections.setup_notes: Offer Gmail during first-use setup; connect only if chosen and scope searches to meeting participants.
